scientific_question: Does one frozen successor controller, extending the R37B composition with a class-level subsumption-aware bounded-variable-elimination operator and completing the already-declared Horn/2CNF terminals, eliminate the exposed R37B stall while preserving certified strict descent, exactness, bounded representation and falsifiable stall detection on preregistered unseen inputs?

definition: For each variable x with both polarities, form all non-tautological Davis-Putnam resolvents.
Combine resolvents with clauses not containing x.
Delete clauses subsumed by another clause in that combined set.
Candidate is admissible only if resulting (C,L,V)_LEX is strictly smaller than the input state.
Choose the admissible candidate with lexicographically smallest resulting CLV, then smallest variable id.
new_progress_operator.class_level_coverage_delta: Covers every reachable canonical CNF state containing at least one variable whose exact DP elimination followed only by logically redundant subsumption deletion strictly decreases CLV; the statement is syntactic and input-independent, not indexed by the exposed witness.
new_progress_operator.semantic_contract: EXISTS x F is satisfiable iff the DP-eliminated formula is satisfiable; subsumption deletion preserves equivalence. SAT models are reconstructed by replaying eliminated positive/negative clause sets in reverse.
new_progress_operator.cost_contract: Enumerating polarity clause pairs, canonicalizing resolvents and pairwise subsumption are charged polynomial scans over the current bounded state; no truth-assignment enumeration is used by the operator.

already_declared_terminal_debt_completio.Horn: Integrate deterministic forward-chaining least-model solve plus independent original-CNF model replay or contradiction replay.
already_declared_terminal_debt_completio.2CNF: Integrate implication-graph SCC satisfiability plus deterministic polynomial witness extraction by repeated SCC checks; independently replay the final model or contradiction.
already_declared_terminal_debt_completio.reason: R33 already recognized HORN and 2CNF as declared polynomial terminals; R42 closes solver-integration debt rather than inventing a new terminal language.

exactness_and_reconstruction.R33: Use existing reconstruction trace and semantic controls.
exactness_and_reconstruction.R35B: Use existing independent RUP replay; vivification is implication-preserving and needs no model-variable reconstruction.
exactness_and_reconstruction.SA_BVE: Store eliminated variable plus all removed positive/negative source clauses; independent checker recomputes full DP resolvents and verifies every omitted resolvent is subsumed; reverse reconstruction chooses a Boolean value satisfying all removed source clauses.
exactness_and_reconstruction.final_SAT: Reconstruct through every R33 and SA_BVE step and replay the model against the original input CNF.
exactness_and_reconstruction.final_UNSAT: Require terminal-specific independent replay; no silent UNSAT assertion.

next_gate_policy.if_no_test_stall: ATTACK_SYMBOLIC_DECIDE_OR_DESCEND_COVERAGE; FINITE PASS DOES NOT CLOSE L2
